plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: phone and its NEW FLAVOR sticker anchor the left, logo sits above a big one-line headline in the centre, and the navy CTA closes the row on the right at the headline's vertical centre.

Left-aligned message column (logo, headline, CTA stacked on one left edge) with the phone and its sticker grouped as the product visual on the right, so the copy reads first and the product closes the banner.
Three-zone banner: brand logo as a quiet left anchor, the phone with its sticker as the centre-left product focus, and the headline stacked over the CTA on a shared left edge in the right half.
